card.name: Declined or refused offers and requests
card.fires_on: The verb of refusal (declined, refused, refusing, turned down, or the 'to' after declined) right after someone is asked or offered something. It appears mostly in news and history prose.

modes.description: A person or body declined or refused a proposal, offer or request.

modes.description: Phrasal or linking words that complete a refusal, such as 'turned down' or 'declined to'.
